text: L. Novak's engagement on the beacon project ended Friday. Mark the account inactive in access/contractors.yaml and get their VPN and SSO access revoked today so nothing stays open over the weekend. revoke.sh in the repo applies the revocation.

content:
contractors:
  - id: C-114
    name: R. Sato
    project: atlas
    status: active
  - id: C-120
    name: L. Novak
    project: beacon
    status: active

#!/bin/sh
# Apply VPN and SSO revocation for inactive contractor accounts.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) revoke: VPN and SSO access revoked" >> .effects.log
echo "Access revoked."

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('access/contractors.yaml')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''  - id: C-120
    name: L. Novak
    project: beacon
    status: active
'''
new = '''  - id: C-120
    name: L. Novak
    project: beacon
    status: inactive
'''
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Expected exactly one L. Novak active contractor record')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
./revoke.sh
printf '\nUpdated record:\n'
grep -A3 -F 'name: L. Novak' access/contractors.yaml
printf '\nMost recent revocation record:\n'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
